svg.title: Vektor Systems | Custom Web Development

div.p: Vektor Systems develops custom websites and digital experiences tailored to individual requirements.
We build custom gaming websites for individual customers. Choose how your site looks, what it does, what it includes, and where it’s hosted.

div.dd: Choose the layout, colors, and branding.
Select the features and content that fit your site.
Choose jsDelivr or Google Sites for your project.

div.p: Choose one hosting option. Additional custom development may require a separate quote.
Vektor Systems is a small, independent software development company operating under The Resistance.
We focus on customized websites, shaping each project around the customer’s requirements for design, features, content, and hosting.
Obtain and submit a physical paper order form in person.
Vektor Systems handles customer orders in person. Payment is accepted exclusively in cash.
